s: Nussach beraka rebiit vedineha, ubo ch' seipim: beraka rebiit potachat be"baruk" sheenah kismuka lachabertah, lepi sheenah mikkelal birkat hammazon ella achar kak nitvassepa, keshennittenu haruge betar liqbura tiqnu birkat "hattob vehammetib", "hattob" — shello hisrichu, "vehammetib" — shennittenu liqbura, uqebauha bebirkat hammazon, shekkullah hodaa, usemakuha etzel "boneh yerushalayim", lepi shekkeshennechreba betar nigdea qeren yisrael, veen atida lachazor ad sheyyabo ben david. Vetzarik lomar bah g' malkuyyot, achat shellah ushettayim bishbil birkat haaretz u"boneh yerushalayim", shello hizkir bahen malkut. Veap al pi shehen semukot lebirkat "hazzan" sheyyesh bah malkut, mikkol maqom, kevan shehizkir malkut bet david be"boneh yerushalayim" — en derek eretz shello yazkir gam ken malkut shamayim bah, ella shello ratzu lehazkir malkut shamayim etzel malkut bet david, lekak tiqnu lehazkir kenegdah malkut be"hattob vehammetib", veaggab shettiqqenu malkut keneged "boneh yerushalayim" — tiqqenu gam ken keneged birkat haaretz. Veellu hen g' malkut: "melek haolam", "abinu malkenu", "hammelek hattob". Ubammidrash ameru shetztzarik lomar bah g' hatabot veg' gemulot. Veellu hen g' hatabot: "hattob" a', "vehammetib" b', "hu hetib metib yetib lanu" g', shehen nechshabin keachat, zeh minhag haolam. Veyesh shehayu nohagim lomar: "hu hetib lanu, hu metib lanu, hu yetib lanu", kederek sheomerim hashshalosh gemulot, shehen: "hu gemalanu hu gomelenu hu yigmelenu":

Ap al pi shehi beraka arukka — enah chotemet be"baruk", mippene shemmittechilla tiqqenuha bematbea qatzar: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, hattob vehammetib" bilbad, veachar kak hosipu bah kol haddebarim hallalu:

En lomar: "el shebbekol yom veyom", ella "el bekol yom". Veyoter nakon shello lomar kelal millat "el", shehare kebar amar: "hael abinu". Veod, sheim ba leyaches hataba leshem "el", haya lo lomar: "hammelek hael hattob vehammetib":

Kesheyyesh nokri babbayit nohagim lomar: "kullanu yachad bene berit", lehotzi hannokri mikkelal habberaka, sheasur lebarek hannokrim, shenneemar "velo techannem". Veyoter nakon lomar: "bene berit kullanu yachad", shello yihyeh biklal habberaka apillu rega, kesheomer: "kullanu yachad" qodem shemmesayyem "bene berit". Venashim vaabadim "bene berit" hem, kemo shekkatub: "tappekem neshekem vego' leobreka bibrit vego'". (Veken hammumar biklal "bene berit" hu, sheap al pi shechata — yisrael hu. Velaken keshemmumar babbayit — en lomar "kullanu yachad bene berit", kede lehotzio mikkelal habberaka):

Bebirkat (hammazon) baal habbayit, mesayyem: "venomar amen", sheen yakol ligzor omer: "veimru amen". Mah sheen ken bebirkat "oseh shalom bimromayv", shehu shebach shel haqqadosh baruk hu, vekol yisrael metzuvvin, omer: "veimru amen" (veap im mebarek leatzmo, omer ken lehammalakim hashshomerim oto):
Kol hambarek et yisrael — mitzva laanot acharayv "amen", velaken yesh laanot "amen" acher "harachaman". Veyomar: "meet Hashem", kilshon happasuq: "yissa beraka meet Hashem vego'":

Nohagim lomar beshabbat veyom tob verosh chodesh: "migdol", kemo shekkatub bishmuel, ubechol: "magdil", kemo shekkatub bithillim. Vesiman: "chodesh veshabbat — qero miqra", rotzeh lomar: kemo shekkatub bannebiim. Veyesh mepaqpeqim bemah sheomerim "harachaman" bekamma gevanim, shehu hepseq ben birkat hammazon lishtiyyat hakkos. Veyesh meyashshebin, shekkevan shennahagu bahem — naasu keillu hem mittopes habberaka, veenam chashubim hepseq:

Bebet haabel mosipim bibraka rebiit meen hamora kol shiba, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman sha"t, ben haabel atzmo shemmebarek, ben acherim sheokelim immo umebarekim bezimmun. Veen chosheshin bebet haabel lomar g' hatabot veg' gemulot sheenan nizkarim battalmud. Ella keshemmaggia le"hammelek hattob" omerim: "hachay hattob vehammetib, el emet, dayyan emet, shopet betzedeq, loqeach nepashot bemishpat, shallit beolamo laasot bo kirtzono, ki kol derakayv mishpat, vaanachnu ammo vaabadayv, ubakkol anu chayyabim lehodot lo uleborko, goder peratzot beyisrael, hu yigdor et happirtza hazzot mealenu umeal abel zeh lechayyim uleshalom, harachaman veku'":
